sloka: पशुः अभ्याहृतः राजन् प्रणष्टः तव दुर्नयात् ।अरक्षितारम् राजानम् घ्नन्ति दोषा नरेश्वर ॥१-६१-७॥
transliteration: paśuḥ abhyāhṛtaḥ rājan praṇaṣṭaḥ tava durnayāt ।arakṣitāram rājānam ghnanti doṣā nareśvara ॥1-61-7॥

translations.english: "O King the animal has been stolen away and because of your inability to enforce law, it could not be traced. O Lord of men the king who fails to protect (his dependents) perishes by his own faults.
translations.hindi: ब्रह्मा जी के इन वचनों को सुन विश्वामित्र जी ने मारे लज्जा के सुख नीचा कर लिया और परम दुःखित हो, दीनतापूर्वक बोले
